subject.title: Dashboard: full-bleed tab layout + "tab app" bundle

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled full-bleed dashboard tab-app mode after the modular-dashboard base lands, or should tab apps remain an external plugin/ClawHub convention unless a missing core seam is proven?
rationale: The request adds a new default-facing dashboard mode around agent-authored app-like widgets, and current main only has the generic plugin-tab seam, not the dashboard substrate or security model needed to approve this automatically.

options.title: Keep As Gated Wave 2 Work
options.body: Leave this issue open as the focused full-bleed/tab-app follow-up and require the Wave 1 dashboard substrate plus sandbox/storage decisions to settle first.

options.title: Prove As External Convention
options.body: Ask for tab-app bundle conventions to prove out as an external plugin or ClawHub package while OpenClaw only exposes missing generic seams.

options.title: Sponsor Core Implementation
options.body: Approve a first-party bundled dashboard full-bleed mode and require explicit security, storage, and upgrade proof with the implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep As Gated Wave 2 Work
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the focused full-bleed/tab-app follow-up and require the Wave 1 dashboard substrate plus sandbox/storage decisions to settle first.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history-backed owner signal for the plugin-tab seam and bundled Control UI product boundary this request builds on.
